posts.author: Priyank_Jain
posts.text: Not sure if this is a bad update. 16% YoY growth when last year Q2 had 9 days of festive sales included (which is clear from flat QoQ last year between Q2 and Q3) if there was no festive days last year in Q2, the sales would not have been more than 40-42cr, if i consider 42cr as base this means 28%+ YoY growth Frankly this quarterly update is quite a relief after Q1 update. I expect them to post 40%+ YoY growth in Q3 which, if happens will make 9M YoY growth at about 25%, which in my view is healthy. PS: Invested and Biased
